title: Union size in a frequency family
statement: Let $n$ and $m$ be natural numbers, let $i$ be a coordinate among $n$ coordinates, and let $S$ and $T$ belong to the following family: all subsets of size at most $m$, together with all subsets of size $m+1$ that contain $i$. Then $|S\cup T|\le 2m+1$.
